1use pdf_writer::Pdf;
2use std::sync::LazyLock;
3use xmp_writer::XmpWriter;
4
5use crate::third_party::krilla::graphics::icc::ICCMetadata;
6use crate::third_party::krilla::graphics::icc::ICCProfile;
7use crate::third_party::krilla::image::BitsPerComponent;
8
9/// The version of a PDF document.
10#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Default)]
11pub enum PdfVersion {
12    /// PDF 1.4.
13    Pdf14,
14    /// PDF 1.5.
15    Pdf15,
16    /// PDF 1.6.
17    Pdf16,
18    /// PDF 1.7.
19    #[default]
20    Pdf17,
21    /// PDF 2.0.
22    Pdf20,
23}
24
25impl PdfVersion {
26    /// The minimum supported PDF version.
27    pub const MIN: Self = Self::Pdf14;
28    /// The maximum supported PDF version.
29    pub const MAX: Self = Self::Pdf20;
30
31    pub(crate) fn write_xmp(&self, xmp: &mut XmpWriter) {
32        match self {
33            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => xmp.pdf_version("1.4"),
34            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => xmp.pdf_version("1.5"),
35            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => xmp.pdf_version("1.6"),
36            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => xmp.pdf_version("1.7"),
37            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => xmp.pdf_version("2.0"),
38        };
39    }
40
41    /// Get a string representation of the PDF version.
42    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
43        match self {
44            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => "PDF 1.4",
45            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => "PDF 1.5",
46            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => "PDF 1.6",
47            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => "PDF 1.7",
48            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => "PDF 2.0",
49        }
50    }
51
52    pub(crate) fn rgb_icc(&self) -> ICCProfile<3> {
53        match self {
54            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => SRGB_V2_ICC.clone(),
55            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => SRGB_V2_ICC.clone(),
56            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => SRGB_V2_ICC.clone(),
57            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => SRGB_V4_ICC.clone(),
58            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => SRGB_V4_ICC.clone(),
59        }
60    }
61
62    pub(crate) fn grey_icc(&self) -> ICCProfile<1> {
63        match self {
64            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => GREY_V2_ICC.clone(),
65            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => GREY_V2_ICC.clone(),
66            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => GREY_V2_ICC.clone(),
67            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => GREY_V4_ICC.clone(),
68            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => GREY_V4_ICC.clone(),
69        }
70    }
71
72    pub(crate) fn supports_icc(&self, metadata: &ICCMetadata) -> bool {
73        match self {
74            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => metadata.major <= 2 && metadata.minor <= 2,
75            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => metadata.major <= 4,
76            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => metadata.major <= 4 && metadata.minor <= 1,
77            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => metadata.major <= 4 && metadata.minor <= 2,
78            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => metadata.major <= 4 && metadata.minor <= 2,
79        }
80    }
81
82    pub(crate) fn supports_bit_depth(&self, bits_per_component: BitsPerComponent) -> bool {
83        match bits_per_component {
84            BitsPerComponent::Eight => true,
85            BitsPerComponent::Sixteen => *self >= PdfVersion::Pdf15,
86        }
87    }
88
89    /// Whether the version supports the `/AF` key.
90    ///
91    /// Note that support for the `/AF` key may instead be provided by the
92    /// PDF/A-3 standard for 1.x series files.
93    pub(crate) fn specifies_associated_files(&self) -> bool {
94        match self {
95            PdfVersion::Pdf14 | PdfVersion::Pdf15 | PdfVersion::Pdf16 | PdfVersion::Pdf17 => false,
96            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => true,
97        }
98    }
99
100    pub(crate) fn set_version(&self, pdf: &mut Pdf) {
101        match self {
102            PdfVersion::Pdf14 => pdf.set_version(1, 4),
103            PdfVersion::Pdf15 => pdf.set_version(1, 5),
104            PdfVersion::Pdf16 => pdf.set_version(1, 6),
105            PdfVersion::Pdf17 => pdf.set_version(1, 7),
106            PdfVersion::Pdf20 => pdf.set_version(2, 0),
107        };
108    }
109
110    pub(crate) fn deprecates_proc_sets(&self) -> bool {
111        *self >= PdfVersion::Pdf20
112    }
113
114    pub(crate) fn deprecates_cid_set(&self) -> bool {
115        *self >= PdfVersion::Pdf20
116    }
117}

119/// The ICC v4 profile for the SRGB color space.
120static SRGB_V4_ICC: LazyLock<ICCProfile<3>> =
121    LazyLock::new(|| ICCProfile::new(include_bytes!("../../../../assets/vendor/krilla/icc/sRGB-v4.icc")).unwrap());
122/// The ICC v2 profile for the SRGB color space.
123static SRGB_V2_ICC: LazyLock<ICCProfile<3>> =
124    LazyLock::new(|| ICCProfile::new(include_bytes!("../../../../assets/vendor/krilla/icc/sRGB-v2-magic.icc")).unwrap());
125/// The ICC v4 profile for the sgray color space.
126static GREY_V4_ICC: LazyLock<ICCProfile<1>> =
127    LazyLock::new(|| ICCProfile::new(include_bytes!("../../../../assets/vendor/krilla/icc/sGrey-v4.icc")).unwrap());
128/// The ICC v2 profile for the sgray color space.
129static GREY_V2_ICC: LazyLock<ICCProfile<1>> =
130    LazyLock::new(|| ICCProfile::new(include_bytes!("../../../../assets/vendor/krilla/icc/sGrey-v2-magic.icc")).unwrap());
